newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus net hard currency reserves seen up in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Belarus net hard currency reserves seen up in 1997.

text.p: The central bank of Belarus plans to boost its net hard currency reserves to $160 million next year from $105 million targeted for the end of 1996, according to a government document obtained by Reuters.

The document, outlining the former Soviet republic's finacial policy for next year, said the central bank would also extend a $275 million loan to the government and $95 million to industrial enterprises, the same as in 1996.
